scripts.dev: bun run kill-ports && concurrently "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:client" "bun run dev:worker" --names "SERVER,CLIENT,WORKER" --prefix-colors "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgYellow.bold" --kill-others-on-fail
scripts.build: bun run build:server && bun run build:worker && bun run build:client
scripts.typecheck: concurrently "bun run --cwd apps/server typecheck" "bun run --cwd apps/client typecheck" "bun run --cwd apps/worker typecheck"
scripts.test: concurrently "bun run --cwd apps/server test" "bun test --cwd apps/worker --isolate" "bun test --cwd packages/auth" "bun test --cwd packages/billing" "bun test --cwd packages/canvas-engine" "bun test --cwd packages/canvas-runtime" "bun test --cwd packages/error-recovery" "bun test --cwd packages/events" "bun test --cwd packages/gateway" "bun test --cwd packages/metrics" "bun test --cwd packages/provider" "bun test --cwd packages/provider-health" "bun test --cwd packages/rate-limit" "bun test --cwd packages/storage" "bun test --cwd packages/subtitle-engine" "bun test --cwd packages/ffmpeg" "bun test --cwd packages/task-engine" "bun test --cwd packages/workflow-engine" "bun test --cwd packages/prompt-engine" "bun test --cwd packages/shared" --names "SERVER,WORKER,AUTH,BILLING,CANVAS,CANVAS-RUNTIME,ERROR-RECOVERY,EVENTS,GATEWAY,METRICS,PROVIDER,PROVIDER-HEALTH,RATE,STORAGE,SUBTITLE,FFMPEG,TASK,WORKFLOW,PROMPT,SHARED" --prefix-colors "bgBlue.bold,bgYellow.bold,bgBlue.bold,bgRed.bold,bgCyan.bold,bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgCyan.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgBlue.bold,bgRed.bold,bgYellow.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgCyan.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgBlue.bold"
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:client
scripts.test:coverage: bun run test --coverage && bun run test:client -- --coverage
